description: ops itself: Renovate tracks the version strings inside verify.yml that Dependabot can't see (the betterleaks pin, the node_version default).
Dependabot keeps the action pins current. Merged updates reach consumer repos only when ops tags a release.

customManagers.description: betterleaks binary in verify.yml: version and the linux_x64 tarball sha256, updated together from the release's checksums file
verify.yml's node_version input default (the Node every consumer gets unless it passes its own)

packageRules.description: Bake time: hold new releases before proposing them (supply-chain age gate).
Never auto-merge in ops: its main only runs Lint, and a merge here is a change to every repo's CI once tagged. Review, merge, then tag.
